title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch Solid Brass Gallery Rail | Glokzin Teal | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch | Allied Brass, Glokzin Teal
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that keeps everyday essentials organized in a compact footprint in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. This Waverly Place collection double glass shelf uses 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and a gallery rail to help keep items in place, while solid brass hardware supports a clean, coordinated look.

Highlights:
- Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Gallery rail helps keep toiletries and décor items from sliding off
- Solid brass hardware for enduring support
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a finished look

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 22 x 5 Inches
- Overall size: 22-Inch length x 5-Inch projection x 8-Inch height
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall mount
- Assembly: no assembly required
- Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4)
- Style: traditional with a transitional, versatile presence to coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
multiple designer finish options available
